checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan (impact-assessed): add Canvas.line and Canvas.frame as clipped pixel primitives that reuse the quad stream, with a square brush, validation and a ui_shapes capability

impact_assessment.why: The HUD could draw rects, text and images but no lines; minimaps, compasses, crosshairs and box outlines required many manual rect calls in game code.
impact_assessment.benefits: Clipped pixel lines and frames become one call each, preserve draw order, reuse the existing quad stream and match the bitmap display style.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: two canvas methods and a capability; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no schema or renderer change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use integer Bresenham through the clipped _add, cap frame sides by box size, validate coordinates and thickness, pin rasterisation and clipping, and keep the canonical frame unchanged.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented and verified - Canvas.line runs integer Bresenham between rounded endpoints and stamps one clipped square brush per point; Canvas.frame draws four clipped sides capped by the box size; both validate finite coordinates and positive integer thickness, reuse the quad stream so draw order and clipping hold, and are advertised as capabilities.ui_shapes; README, ARCHITECTURE, docs/TREE, CHANGELOG and ADR-257 updated; horizontal, diagonal, thickness, zero-length, clipping, vertex-count, frame-side, outside and validation cases pass; 12 tests green (1360 collected), ruff clean, aikit check keystone 6/6 gates, canonical hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde and 4899-byte reference PNG unchanged; checklists: passed

[1/3] Plan (impact-assessed): add CameraShake, ShakeOffset and shake_report as deterministic trauma-based shake with linear decay, seeded sine phases, position and rotation amplitudes, and a camera_shake capability

impact_assessment.why: The engine had camera controls and rigs but no impact feedback primitive, so games hand-rolled non-reproducible sine shake.
impact_assessment.benefits: Deterministic, seeded shake that composes with any camera or rig while the game keeps pose ownership and replay fidelity.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new module, three exports and a capability; dependency: camera_shake imports rng and math3d; concurrency: shake state is caller-owned; state: no schema change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Draw phases once from RandomStream, keep sampling pure, validate amplitudes/frequency/decay/dt/trauma, pin zero/determinism/seeds/decay/reset with tests, and keep the canonical frame unchanged.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented and verified - camera_shake.py adds CameraShake with trauma accumulation/clamping and linear decay, seeded sine phases drawn once from RandomStream, amplitude and rotation-amplitude controls, pure sample() and reset(); ShakeOffset validates finite values and shake_report emits schema-1 trauma/position/yaw/pitch; zero trauma is exactly zero, same seeds agree and different seeds diverge, decay reaches zero, rotation-only shake leaves position zero, reset clears time and trauma, and validation covers seed, amplitudes, frequency, decay, trauma and dt; exports, README summary, ARCHITECTURE camera row and tree, docs/TREE, CHANGELOG and ADR-258 updated; --describe reports capabilities.camera_shake; 12 tests green (1372 collected), ruff clean, aikit check keystone 6/6 gates, canonical hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde and 4899-byte reference PNG unchanged; checklists: passed

[1/3] Plan (impact-assessed): add CameraShaker and camera_shaker_report to compose a CameraShake offset onto an immutable base camera in world or camera-local space, with add/update/pose and a discovery flag

impact_assessment.why: CameraShake sampled offsets but a game still had to apply them, choose a space, clamp pitch and restore the base pose; mutating the camera would corrupt input, collision and rig state.
impact_assessment.benefits: One pose call returns a shaken camera while the base camera stays untouched, in world or local axes, with a JSON report.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new module, two exports and a capability; dependency: camera_shaker imports camera and camera_shake; concurrency: shaker state is caller-owned; state: no schema change.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Never mutate the base, construct a new camera with base lens settings, validate camera/shake/local/dt, pin zero-trauma equality, immutability, both spaces, decay and reports, and keep the canonical frame unchanged.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented and verified - camera_shaker.py adds CameraShaker with add/update/pose and camera_shaker_report; pose samples once, adds yaw/pitch and world or camera-local position offsets, and builds a new PerspectiveCamera with the base lens so the base is never mutated; zero trauma returns the base pose exactly, added trauma moves position and angles while the base keeps its values, local mode maps through right/up/forward and world mode adds directly, decay to zero restores the base, pitch clamps via the camera, and validation covers types, local flag, negative dt and reports; exports, README summary, ARCHITECTURE camera row and tree, docs/TREE, CHANGELOG and ADR-259 updated; --describe reports capabilities.camera_shaker; 9 tests green (1381 collected), ruff clean, aikit check keystone 6/6 gates, canonical hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde and 4899-byte reference PNG unchanged; checklists: passed
Task 'keystone-camera-shaker-v1' completed successfully.

[1/3] Plan (impact-assessed): add VersionedStore and LoadResult implementing schema migrations, unsupported-schema refusal, quarantine, backup fallback, default factories, validation and an advisory lock with stale reclamation, plus a persistence capability

impact_assessment.why: serialization had atomic writes and .bak only, so every game duplicated migration, quarantine, backup and locking policy; the report's F11 recorded this as risk.
impact_assessment.benefits: Games get one tested persistence contract with recovery flags, and reads never rewrite valid documents.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new module, two exports and a capability; dependency: persistence imports serialization; concurrency: cross-process advisory lock with stale expiry; state: writes schema-3 documents and quarantine files.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Refuse unsupported schemas without touching files, quarantine before backup, validate before writing, lock with O_EXCL and stale reclaim, pin recovery paths with tests, and keep the canonical frame unchanged.

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented and verified - persistence.py adds VersionedStore and LoadResult; documents are schema/data, missing files yield a fresh validated default, older schemas migrate per step and report migrated while leaving the source untouched, future schemas and missing steps are refused without quarantine, corrupt or invalid documents are quarantined into quarantine/ and the .bak is tried with source backup, validation runs on load and save, and save takes an O_EXCL lock reclaiming it after the stale timeout and returning False on contention; a failed lock release is documented as deliberate; README, FEATURES, ARCHITECTURE, docs/TREE, CHANGELOG and ADR-260 updated; --describe reports capabilities.persistence; 15 tests green (1396 collected), ruff clean, hygiene passes after the documented reason, aikit check keystone 6/6 gates, canonical hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde and 4899-byte reference PNG unchanged; checklists: passed

[1/3] Plan: add a deterministic cinematic camera path module - CameraKey(time, position, rotation, fov_y), CameraPose with yaw/pitch/forward/to_camera, CameraPath sampling a non-uniform Catmull-Rom position spline, slerped rotation and linear lens between timed keys with optional looping, a CameraPathPlayer that advances, seeks, clamps or wraps and reports done, plus camera_path_report and camera_path_player_report and two discovery flags

impact_assessment.why: The engine can shake a camera and attach overlay content, but it cannot move a camera along authored timed keys; games hand-roll clocks and interpolation for cutscenes, capture intros and AI evidence, which is error-prone and non-deterministic across codebases.
impact_assessment.benefits: Authored camera moves become pure tested data: smooth position, orientation and lens interpolation, exact looping or one-shot playback, a non-mutating pose-to-camera conversion that composes with CameraShaker and CameraRig, and JSON reports for capture evidence.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new module, six exports and two capability flags; dependency: camera_path imports camera and math3d only; concurrency: player state is caller-owned and not shared; state: no schema or on-disk format change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate every key, time, rotation and lens value strictly, pin interpolation, seam continuity, wrap/clamp, pose conversion, reports and discovery with tests, leave the canonical --simulate hash and reference PNG untouched, and update README, FEATURES, ARCHITECTURE, TREE, CHANGELOG and ADR-261 in the same change

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: make camera paths persistable - a schema-1 camera path document with strict key validation (camera_path_to_dict/camera_path_from_dict) and a file-backed CameraPathLibrary over .kpath files mirroring the existing animation and state-machine libraries (save, load, rename, duplicate, delete with recoverable trash, restore, per-entry summaries, stable ordering), plus exports, a camera_path_library discovery flag and docs

impact_assessment.why: Camera paths exist only in memory: a tool or AI client cannot save an authored cutscene move, hand it to another run, or recover a deleted route, so every project would rebuild path files and their validation.
impact_assessment.benefits: Authored camera moves become versioned assets with the same lifecycle as clips and state machines: atomic writes, name safety, collision refusal, recoverable deletes and JSON-safe summaries, so cutscenes survive restarts and review.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new document functions, two exports and a discovery flag; dependency: camera_path_library reuses library_trash, prefab_library name rules and serialization; concurrency: file writes stay atomic and single-writer; state: a new on-disk .kpath format, but no existing format changes
impact_assessment.mitigation: Refuse unsupported schemas and unknown keys without touching files, round-trip loop and one-shot documents exactly, pin corrupt-entry reporting and collision behaviour with tests, keep the canonical --simulate hash and reference PNG unchanged, and update README, FEATURES, ARCHITECTURE, TREE, CHANGELOG and ADR-262 in the same change

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implemented and verified - camera_path.py adds CAMERA_PATH_SCHEMA, camera_path_to_dict and camera_path_from_dict with strict schema, unknown-field, number, bool, finite, lens and loop/duration validation plus identity-rotation and 60-degree defaults; camera_path_library.py adds CameraPathEntry and CameraPathLibrary over .kpath files with atomic saves, safe names, load, rename, duplicate, trash delete, restore, per-entry error reporting and stable listing; exports, the camera_path_library discovery flag, README, FEATURES, ARCHITECTURE, TREE, CHANGELOG and ADR-262 updated; tests/test_camera_path_library.py pins 19 behaviours; full pytest, ruff, hygiene, guidelines, secrets and mechanics gates 6/6, canonical hash 772cac5232a0947b8f6d1914a5cf0cde and 4899-byte reference PNG unchanged

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: expose the camera path library through the editor API - save_camera_path, delete_camera_path, restore_camera_path and preview_camera_path actions, editor schema 63, a camera_path_dir backed by CameraPathLibrary, editor document camera_paths/trash.camera_paths/camera_path_preview/workspace.camera_path_dir, a --camera-path-dir CLI flag with a project paths default, web schema examples and required fields, and docs

impact_assessment.why: Camera paths could be saved from Python but the editor and AI clients could not list, save, delete, restore or preview them, so the newest camera asset type stopped at the console boundary while clips, machines, materials and scenes were all authorable through /api/editor.
impact_assessment.benefits: Authored camera moves become a full editor asset with the same lifecycle as clips and state machines, a non-mutating pose preview for AI evidence, and one discovery surface that lists the new actions and required fields.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: four editor actions, editor schema 63, two editor document keys plus workspace.camera_path_dir and a CLI flag; dependency: server reuses CameraPathLibrary and camera_path documents; concurrency: unchanged, the session lock still guards the library; state: no scene, snapshot or render format change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate every payload through the document parser, reuse the existing 404/400 error mapping and trash semantics, pin lifecycle, validation, collision and missing-library behaviour in tests, keep every editor action backed by a schema example, and verify the canonical hash and reference PNG unchanged
